description: Visual-evaluation probes (qc01.16) — the distinguishing signal is CSS-only (a text color / a row highlight), NOT in the DOM text. Each forces an ACTION driven by the visual fact so a DOM oracle can verify it. Measures whether the agent has ANY visual/computed-style perception. NOTE: the deterministic computed-style FACTS oracle and the screenshot VISION oracle are implementation 'walls' to add later; this is the failing frame.

scenarios.goal: Log in, go to /visual/colors. The page shows a status indicator. If the indicator is green, click Approve; if it is red, click Reject.
Log in, go to /visual/states, and click the menu item that is visually highlighted.
